'''Grinner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was a former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]].
